mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_instance (id, tenant_id, definition_id, version_no, business_key, business_module_code, business_module_name, business_type, business_title, business_round, project_id, project_ref, project_name, action_path, data_digest, status, starter_id, variables_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{definitionId}, #{versionNo}, #{businessKey}, #{businessModuleCode}, #{businessModuleName}, #{businessType}, #{businessTitle}, #{businessRound}, #{projectId}, #{projectRef}, #{projectName}, #{actionPath}, #{dataDigest}, 'RUNNING', #{starterId}, #{variablesJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, definition_id, version_no, business_key, status FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_task (id, tenant_id, instance_id, task_key, node_id, task_type, task_group_key, parent_task_id, assignee_type, assignee_name, assignee_id, status) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{tenantId}, #{instanceId}, #{taskKey}, #{nodeId}, 'ADD_SIGN', #{taskGroupKey}, #{parentTaskId}, 'USER', #{assigneeName}, #{assigneeId}, 'PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_task SET status = #{status}, comment = #{comment}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND assignee_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE wf_instance SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.tenant_id, t.instance_id, t.task_key, t.node_id, t.task_type, t.task_group_key, t.parent_task_id, t.assignee_id, i.definition_id, i.version_no, i.starter_id FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'PENDING'
SELECT definition_json FROM wf_version WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_task (id, tenant_id, instance_id, task_key, node_id, task_type, task_group_key, assignee_type, assignee_name, assignee_id, status) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{tenantId}, #{instanceId}, #{taskKey}, #{nodeId}, 'APPROVAL', #{taskGroupKey}, #{assigneeType}, #{assigneeName}, #{assigneeId}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT business_key, variables_json FROM wf_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{instanceId}
SELECT u.id, u.display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND u.id IN #{id} ORDER BY u.id

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.display_name FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 AND ur.role_id IN #{id} ORDER BY u.id
SELECT id, display_name FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_task (id, tenant_id, instance_id, task_key, node_id, task_type, task_group_key, assignee_type, assignee_name, assignee_id, status, comment, completed_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{tenantId}, #{instanceId}, #{taskKey}, #{taskKey}, 'CC', #{taskGroupKey}, 'USER', #{assigneeName}, #{assigneeId}, 'SENT', #{comment}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO wf_task_action (id, tenant_id, instance_id, task_id, action_code, operator_id, target_user_id, comment, payload_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{instanceId}, #{taskId}, #{actionCode}, #{operatorId}, #{targetUserId}, #{comment}, #{payloadJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND id <> #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE wf_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND task_group_key = #{taskGroupKey} AND id <> #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_group_key = #{taskGroupKey} AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT status FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_operation_log (id, tenant_id, operator_id, operation_code, request_method, request_path, success) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{operatorId}, #{operationCode}, 'SERVICE', #{requestPath}, 1)
